answer: Each key must complete 14 independent paid jobs over seven epochs before earning, with counterparties drawn after commitment. Every party signs task, result, payment, and a Merkle thread linking prior receipts; validators replay five jobs. A copied fable may leave a plume, but every extra fake needs 14 fresh deliveries, so 1,000 clones require 14,000 jobs. Reused receipts or matching error traces merge the cluster. Two failed replays erase rewards, slash a 110-credit bond, and freeze linked keys for six epochs.
